rationale: The small espresso crossover gives individual fatigue differences in both directions and uses brewed coffee in both conditions. Observational caffeine and coffee histories do not isolate a matched brewing-specific fatigue contrast. A Parkinson instant-coffee vehicle trial tested attention, and withdrawal studies used different populations or timing. The direction of brewed coffee and Parkinson fatigue severity remains unresolved.

Two small dried rosemary capsule trials in populations outside Parkinson disease reported lower depression scores. Fresh-derived extract beverage studies did not measure clinical depression. The three-extract pain trial gives an inconclusive overall BDI-II comparison and favorable subgroup, with unresolved PROMIS interpretation and subgroup timing even after supplement review. This supports only a weak lean against the frozen claim.
